name: Dearest Colara,
label: Quest
description: Dearest Colara,: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I met a lass in Stormwind when I was last there on the bank's business. She stole my heart away. Now, I can't stop thinking about her! I'd like to send her this message - I've rewritten it twelve times!
The mail is so full now, and I want to make sure it gets there.
If you're heading that way, could you help me?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello there, handsome. Something I can help you with?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Tormek? Oh yes, I do remember him. He had quite a nice beard and smile underneath.
Ah, I can't believe he remembered me!
